# Dulten Richard Fromentin

Intended public website: https://dultenrichard.github.io/

Dulten Richard Fromentin is a Grade 12 student in Brockville, Ontario. This public record covers cadet instruction and leadership, employment, 205 completed community-involvement hours, education, sport, and projects.

## Clarifications
Cadet service began November 8, 2021. Warrant Officer Second Class since November 11, 2025. Mock-trial awards were earned at PECI in April 2025. TISS completion is expected February 2027; the OSSD is in progress. Manufacturing SHSM is complete. Leadership Lab is in development; no workshop has yet been delivered. COSSA rugby recognition was silver. The Bright Future record is a nomination.

For evidence, use the Sources page and specific records linked there. Copies or proof of awards are held on file and available on request. Background water imagery is original atmospheric artwork, not documentary imagery of a location.
